label: Project
description: A construction job. Every project-scoped record points at one

label: Party
description: A company or person on the job: owner, designer, contractor, subcontractor, supplier, inspector

label: Document
description: A file or sheet: drawing, specification, contract, photo, report, invoice. Records cite documents as evidence

label: Specification section
description: One section of the project specification, numbered in MasterFormat. RFIs, submittals and assets hang off it

label: RFI
description: A request for information: a question to the design team and its answer

label: Submittal
description: Product data, shop drawings or samples sent for review. One record per revision

label: Change event
description: Something that may change cost or time, before it is priced and agreed (a potential change order)

label: Change order
description: An agreed change to the owner contract or to a subcontract or purchase order

label: Commitment
description: A subcontract or purchase order let on the project

label: Budget line
description: One line of the project budget: a cost code and cost type

label: Cost line
description: One posted cost: an AP invoice line, payroll, equipment or journal entry

label: Billing
description: A pay application or invoice to the owner, with the retainage on it

label: Schedule activity
description: One activity in the project schedule

label: Daily log
description: The site's record of one day: work, labour, weather, delays, inspections

label: Observation
description: Something seen on site that needs attention: a hazard, a quality issue, an issue logged in a platform

label: Punch item
description: One item on the punch list near completion

label: Asset
description: An installed piece of equipment or component handed over to the owner, the bridge to COBie
